> Specifically because the login can fail on boot of the Pi, probably because the internet connection is not fully setup.

That sounds like solving a problem in the wrong place. This is probably happening on a Home Assistant Core installation with an incorrect setup/configured service. A service that requires network, should not start before the network is started.

@frenck could you have another look?
I now raise ConfigEntryNotReady or ConfigEntryAuthFailed when they are applicable.
I think this is ready to be merged.

issue_context.title: Issues with platform: xiaomi_miio - Forgetting credentials everytime Raspberry Pi is rebooted
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Credentials are forgotten every time the Raspberry Pi is rebooted. It doesn't forget the credentials when HA is restarted, but id forgets every time it is rebooted.

Problem appeared after updating to HA 2021.07.04 from an unknown Version (please let me know if there is a way to know the version I was using before). I have already tried to update to HA 2021.08.06 but it made no difference.

I have already tried to reinstall the integration as well.

python-miio Version: 0.5.6
Server: de

Thanks in advance. Please let me know if I can provide any needed information

![1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/68345503/129240248-535cd9ed-e2f8-4873-9af7-a046a2b33fa3.png)
![2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/68345503/129240250-c0c57f36-aea1-4652-9f7d-d3888a53e13e.png)
![3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/68345503/129240252-e54d69cf-d928-4ce2-a76a-828dcb81ec7e.png)
![4](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/68345503/129240257-eb9b72a1-3ea0-4a80-96d7-366b8a110da8.png)


### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.8.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

xiaomi_miio

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/xiaomi_miio/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Logger: homeassistant.config_entries
Source: config_entries.py:307
First occurred: 7:13:48 PM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 7:13:48 PM

Config entry 'Mi Control Hub' for xiaomi_miio integration could not authenticate: Could not login to Xioami Miio Cloud, check the credentials
```


### Additional information

_No response_

<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

Thanks for reporting this, I have not yet experianced this problem but I will look into it.

The relevant piece of code is this:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/75275254f99a4f52492f09a608e26edf3277384d/homeassistant/components/xiaomi_miio/gateway.py#L118-L121

I am guessing the internet connection is not fully setup or something when the Pi boots, which causes the login error.

I think the easiest solution would be to just do let's say 3 times a retry with 30 seconds inteval in-between before raising the ConfigEntryAuthFailed.

> Thanks for reporting this, I have not yet experianced this problem but I will look into it.
> 
> The relevant piece of code is this:
> https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/75275254f99a4f52492f09a608e26edf3277384d/homeassistant/components/xiaomi_miio/gateway.py#L118-L121
> 
> I am guessing the internet connection is not fully setup or something when the Pi boots, which causes the login error.
> 
> I think the easiest solution would be to just do let's say 3 times a retry with 30 seconds inteval in-between before raising the ConfigEntryAuthFailed.

That is interesting and makes sense, since I have a fairly intricate internet connection startup that rely on some timers to be set properly. A retry 3 times with interval could solve it. 

EDIT: I can help testing code, if needed.
I just made a PR to implement the retries: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/54696
